description: This file defines the Education Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for reporting functionalities related to employee education details. It includes methods for converting employee education data into an array format suitable for display or export, utilizing traits and references to external entity classes.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: A DTO class representing employee education data, providing methods to normalize and extract education information for reporting purposes.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the education data of an employee into an array containing specified fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Education DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their corresponding getter methods in related entities.
